description: This file defines the LayoutBuilderEntityViewDisplay class, which extends Drupal's base entity view display to add layout-building capabilities, including methods for enabling/disabling layout builder, managing sections, components, dependencies, and handling configuration for entity view displays with layout features.

classes.name: LayoutBuilderEntityViewDisplay
classes.description: A class extending Drupal's EntityViewDisplay to support layout building, including methods for managing layout sections, components, dependencies, and configuration for entity view displays with layout features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class, setting the entity field manager service before calling parent constructor.

methods.name: isOverridable
methods.description: Checks if the layout is overridable based on layout builder status and third-party settings.

methods.name: setOverridable
methods.description: Sets whether the layout is overridable and enables layout builder if necessary.

methods.name: isLayoutBuilderEnabled
methods.description: Checks if layout builder is enabled, excluding custom mode.

methods.name: enableLayoutBuilder
methods.description: Enables layout builder for the entity display.

methods.name: disableLayoutBuilder
methods.description: Disables layout builder for the entity display.

methods.name: getSections
methods.description: Retrieves layout sections from third-party settings.

methods.name: setSections
methods.description: Sets layout sections in third-party settings, unsetting if empty.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Handles logic before saving, including section field management and enabling/disabling layout builder.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity and clears block cache if specific module is not enabled.

methods.name: removeSectionField
methods.description: Removes a layout section field if no other view modes are using it.

methods.name: addSectionField
methods.description: Adds a layout section field to a bundle if it does not exist.

methods.name: createCopy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the display with sections removed and layout builder disabled.

methods.name: getDefaultRegion
methods.description: Returns the default region of the first section or parent default.

methods.name: contextRepository
methods.description: Provides the context repository service.

methods.name: isCustomMode
methods.description: Checks if the display is using the '_custom' view mode.

methods.name: buildMultiple
methods.description: Builds render arrays for multiple entities, including layout sections if enabled.

methods.name: buildSections
methods.description: Builds render array for sections of an entity.

methods.name: getContextsForEntity
methods.description: Returns context objects for a given entity.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns a label for the entity view display, including bundle and entity type labels.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates plugin dependencies for sections and components.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies, removing sections or components if dependencies are missing.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Sets a component, converting it to a section component if display is layout-enabled, and appends to default section.

methods.name: getDefaultSection
methods.description: Returns the default section, creating one if none exists.

methods.name: sectionStorageManager
methods.description: Returns the section storage manager service.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Retrieves component configuration, including formatter if layout is enabled.

methods.name: getSectionComponentForFieldName
methods.description: Finds a section component associated with a specific field name.
